tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.2
§ Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"
a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly;
